recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is; further edits would be editorial duplication rather than a necessary correction to implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-7355 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 section 1.10.2 and asked to clarify confusing BaseResource common-property wording that said all resources have optional or mandatory identity, metadata, language, and implicitRules properties.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in git commit a6f3e671994f186f7c9902f033e8166e385937de, whose git-svn metadata matches the Jira comment's svn revision 6431. That commit changed the old sentence to say the optional elements and properties are defined for all resources.
additional_context: The Resource infrastructure source is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current Resource StructureDefinition gives Resource.id, Resource.meta, Resource.implicitRules, and Resource.language cardinality 0..1. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final issue or community discussion changing that conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current narrative no longer says every resource instance has the listed elements, and the authoritative cardinalities already express that the common Resource elements may be absent.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive clarification asking to make BaseResource common-property wording less confusing about optional elements.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final WG request as a non-substantive clarification of optional common Resource properties.

evidence_items.summary: The current narrative says the optional elements and properties are defined for all resources.
evidence_items.learned: The old misleading wording that all resources have those elements is absent from the current source.

evidence_items.summary: Commit #7355 - clarify changed the old common-properties sentence and includes git-svn revision 6431.
evidence_items.learned: This ties the current wording directly to the Jira application noted in the issue comment.

evidence_items.summary: Resource.id, meta, implicitRules, and language are each defined with cardinality 0..1.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative element definitions preserve the intended optionality of the common Resource elements.
